name: Wrenn and Seven
oracle_text:
+1: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
0: Put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
−3: Create a green Treefolk creature token with reach and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."
−8: Return all permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."
blocked_sentences: −3: Create a green Treefolk creature token with reach and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."

needs.what: a 0/0 green Treefolk creature token with reach and the characteristic-defining static "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control." (set_pt from a count of lands you control, read continuously)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Treefolk token; the nearest is elemental_x_x_gw_creature_count, which is a green white Elemental counting creatures rather than lands and has no reach. create_token's power/toughness options fix the size at creation and would not track lands entering or leaving. The other three loyalty lines (look_at_top with a Land selector to hand and rest_to graveyard; put_onto_battlefield of any number of land cards from hand tapped; return_to_hand of permanent cards from graveyard plus an emblem with the no_hand_limit static) look expressible
